Maya (Vendor Ops): Vendor NodeWave Partners submitted invoice NW-0503 for $48,200. They listed two legal names on the PDF (NodeWave BV / NodeWave LLC) and included a NL VAT ID. They asked if Redwood can pay USD ACH or crypto. Invoice: https://files.redwood/nodewave/invoice-0503.png

Owen (Finance): Payment method doesn't change tax docs. We need to know which legal entity actually issued this invoice. If it's NodeWave LLC (US) -> W-9. If NodeWave BV (Netherlands) -> W-8BEN-E for non-US entity + VAT verification for reverse-charge. Also need clear remit instructions (bank name / crypto wallet name).

Priya (AP): Putting invoice on hold: HOLD_CODE = TAX_DOCS_PENDING. Please request: 1) invoice reissue from a single legal entity; 2) certificate of incorporation for that entity; 3) completed W-9 or W-8BEN-E as applicable; 4) VAT verification screenshot if NL VAT on invoice; 5) service description (platform usage vs royalties). CC ap-docs@redwood on upload.

Carlos (NodeWave): Hi team  we are NodeWave BV (NL) for EU contracts but founders are US and sometimes our US arm issues invoices for US customers. This time we export from NL systems so VAT got filled. We can reissue from BV or LLC, whichever Redwood prefers. On gross-up: our payments team says if USD payments route via US entity there may be backup withholding; can Redwood gross-up to cover any withholding?

tax-bot: VIES lookup: NL987654321B02 -> STATUS: VALID (checked 2026-05-02 14:58 UTC).

Liam (Tax): Thanks Carlos. Two quick things: (1) Reissue from one entity only and attach incorporation docs. (2) If you invoice from NodeWave BV and its a B2B supply with a valid NL VAT (and we are a business with a VAT ID), we would generally apply reverse-charge and no VAT should be charged. If invoice is from NodeWave LLC (US), we need a W-9 and we may have backup withholding obligations if TIN missing or mismatch. Gross-up is not standard practice unless contractually agreed; we generally don't gross-up for vendor withholding.

Maya (Vendor Ops): Carlos, please confirm: which entity will you reissue from and include the exact legal name, registration number, and VAT verification link/screenshot. Also clarify whether the work is performed in the US or fully offshore.

Carlos (NodeWave): We'll reissue from NodeWave BV and include the NL VAT verification and company extract. Work is performed by our EU engineering team (Netherlands), not US. No royalties, it's platform access/subscription. We'll also include a signed statement that the invoicing entity is non-US and provide W-8BEN-E if you still want that despite EU billing.

Priya (AP): Perfect. Once we receive the reissued invoice and docs I'll remove hold and route for payment. Reminder: ap-docs@redwood must receive a single ZIP with: invoice, company extract, VAT verification, and completed tax form.

Owen (Finance): Noted. If NodeWave BV provides valid VAT + W-8BEN-E asserting foreign status, we won't withhold. If anything looks like royalties or US-source services after doc review, Tax will advise.

Liam (Tax): Exactly. One more ask: please ensure the invoice line item explicitly says "platform subscription / inference compute" to avoid ambiguity on royalties. Thanks. :thumbsup:

Carlos (NodeWave): Will do. Reissue and upload within the day. Thanks everyone.
